node.title: All-admissible-row F2 O1 mass bound
node.statement: The F2 first-moment bound (O1), E_c[T_W(c)]<=2^{m+o(n)}, holds at the full-group deployed window for every official admissible n=2^41 row. This is false whenever ord_n(p)<[F_q:F_p]; in particular p=3*2^41+1 and q=p^6 give an admissible counterexample with an exponential 2^{5n/12} excess under the governing nested reading.
